title: The Own domain card footer tells a Cloudflare customer to keep the CNAME DNS only (grey cloud)
steps: S1: Read domains.checkedAt, domains.dnsOnly, domains.bareName, domains.holdUntil and domains.record.routing in packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/src/client/strings.ts and the same keys in the seven other interface languages.
S2: Read the CNAME, TXT (ownership) and certificate (validation) row labels.
S3: Render the Own domain card (component test) unchecked, checked, probed (certificate pending), with a hold, unsupported and lapsed; the whole suite must pass.
expect: S1: in English and every other language domains.dnsOnly names Cloudflare, CNAME, DNS only and the grey cloud, and the four footer keys keep their placeholders; in every other language the CNAME row label is back to its short wording.
S2: no row label carries the instruction (no DNS only, no Cloudflare).
S3: a dns-only line follows the checked-at line directly (unchecked too); there is none on an unsupported or lapsed domain.
evidence: Dev machine 10/10/2026: www.genieos.ai stayed Pending Validation (HTTP) with the CNAME proxied and went active/active within minutes once it was DNS only; the card never said so. Product owner 11/10/2026: the hint goes in the footer, not on the CNAME row label.
fence: Static read of the footer strings in the source dictionary and every locale dictionary (tracy-site-tabs string test), plus the card footer component assertions
